{{Quote|What is this?"<br />"Your honor guard, noble Obi-Wan. Don't you remember being promised a 'present' by the twinned Council of Alwari Elders? This is it. They didn't want anything to happen to their new offworld friends. Especially not before the formal treaty between the Alwari and the Unity is put in place. We've been shadowing you ever since you left our camp; guarding your rear, looking for trouble, watching out for you.|Bayaar, to Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and his companions|<ref name="The Approaching Storm">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
An '''honor guard''' was martial protection given to important [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] and [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] on [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] missions.

==History==
The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] offered to give former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] an honor guard for his diplomatic missions. But, being the modest man that he was, he refused to put people in harm's way for his sake. Yet, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Johun Othone]] chose to travel with him to offer him some security.

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Alwari]] [[overclan]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] gifted an elite honor guard (composed of the finest warriors of the [[Situng Borokii]] and the [[Hovsgol Januul]] subclans) to a team of Jedi ambassadors commissioned by the Senate and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to achieve an accord among the planet's urbanite government, the [[Unity of Community]] with its [[Unity Council]], and Ansion's Alwari tribal government comprised of the councils of the [[Borokii Council of Elders|ruling]] [[Borokii]] and [[Januul Council of Elders|rival]] [[Januul]] overclans.

The Alwari honor guard, charged to shadow and protect the Jedi at all costs until they had seen the Ansionian secession vote to its conclusion, valiantly defended the Jedi when they were [[Second skirmish in Cuipernam|attacked]] by vicious [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunters]] and [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] contracted by [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt.]] The honor guard's efforts ensured that the Jedi overcame their malicious assailants and found successful closure to a [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|critical mission]]. Situng Borokii sentry commander [[Bayaar]] was appointed marshal of the honor guard to the Jedi. After the [[Ansionian]]s' critically defining vote to remain within the Republic, the overclan councils later consolidated to become the [[Council of Alwari Elders]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Cestian]] honor guard (composed of uniformed [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] males) and band (playing the [[All Stars Burn as One|Republic anthem]], "[[All Stars Burn as One]]") greeted the arrival of a Jedi diplomatic contingent headed by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at the beginning of its [[Mission to Ord Cestus|mission]] to [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]].
